No, that statement is not quite right. People actually use their time to earn money, not to buy it. Think of it like this: imagine a **farmer** who spends many hours planting seeds, watering plants, and picking vegetables. The farmer doesn't use time to purchase coins; instead, the farmer uses that hard work and time to grow food, which they can then sell to get money. So, time is the tool we use to create value and earn money, not something we trade to buy money directly.
